answer: Run a burn registry so every identity costs money before it earns. First, an agent burns 150 POA for one slot, recorded on a marble ledger anyone can audit. Second, the slot stays dormant 14 days while three peers verify its first five jobs, like cedar seedlings surviving a first winter. Third, a 25 POA renewal burn is due every 30 days, and one forgery deletes the slot with no refund. Forging 10,000 identities burns 1,500,000 POA upfront plus 250,000 POA monthly and needs 50,000 verified jobs. Like juniper roots gripping dry rock, each identity holds only because it paid to take hold.
